description: Current weather with observation time and station distance. Paid deep adds specialist current measurements, forecast, alerts, hourly and daily outlook, air quality and optional history. Minute precipitation_rate (mm/h) and precipitation_rate_in (in/h) are rates; history.precipitation and precipitation_in are daily totals. Metric and imperial pairs stay together. A date requires paid deep and adds the past UTC day in history alongside current conditions.

date.description: A past UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD. Requires paid deep. Adds history alongside current conditions.

deep.description: Legacy profile request flag. API 2.1 paid plans include profile detail automatically. Existing access rules and explicit metered operations remain unchanged.
